displayDescription: One continuous pan across a registered engraving plate as a carved light trace grows from seed to a connected node network.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Engraving is a procedural Canvas 2D approximation: seeded stipple, tone-modulated parallel hatch and crosshatch stand in for physical burin cuts; no real plate relief, ink transfer or paper texture is simulated.
Carved-light depth is suggested by an offset dark shadow cut beneath a light stroke, not by lighting or a height map.
No reviewed preview recipes were supplied (STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes) and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json exists, so the preview demonstrates the primary Motion Graphic action only.
Blender was not used, per the user's instruction.

creative_pool.select_project_technologies failed with a host error (PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json missing), so the technology record was not written; runtime uses only the browser Canvas 2D API and the supplied local gsap.min.js.

The engraving texture is softened (cached 1 px blur, low mark contrast of about 13 luma levels over the plate) and the long take covers a compressed 1440-unit plate with a gentle ~280 px pan (at most ~5 px per frame), so the registered marks stay coherent through video encoding; finer burin-scale density and a longer traverse are approximated.
